## 9. Diagnostics - does India VIX add information beyond ATR?

For a band centred on the previous close, a session is fully contained exactly when the predicted half-width >= required half-width = max(High - PrevClose, PrevClose - Low). The rank correlation between predicted and required half-width measures whether a model widens on the right days (timing), independently of how wide it is on average (level). No parameters involved.
